method.formula: 100/(1+distance/scale), scales 50 m for paths and 250 m for parks; weighted sum; ties by site ID
method.buffers_note: Prototype screening choices, not legal setbacks

note: OSM-only licence fallback: a proximity screen of simulated 30 m cells, not a second model, not a planting approval and not a shade survey. Ranks use footpath and park proximity only. Heat, existing tree cover, actual shade, utilities, soil, ownership and species suitability are unknown. Scores cannot be compared with the satellite model. Mapping gaps can omit land, buildings and paths.
conflict_note: Mapped geometry triggers for field review, not an approval or a legal setback check. It looks only at mapped roads, buildings and footpaths (for tree-fall, clearance and access review) and does not assess wildlife: no forest-edge layer is mapped, and that would need an ecologist. Distances are from the edge of a simulated 30 m cell; the final tree position is unknown. OSM roads are centre lines, not kerbs. No mapped trigger does not establish safety. Utilities, overhead wires, sight lines, ownership, drainage and species/root clearances remain unknown until checked on site.
